ruleDefinitions.name: Add New Download Source To Winget
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of winget to add new additional download sources

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\winget\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "winget\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*source\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*add\\ .*")))
